# Mode30_WriteAndConditionalDispatch — 0x569530

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.py. -->

Original x86 writes incoming EAX at owner+0x30 then, for a nonempty member vector, conditionally invokes 0x569730 for the first local +0x1867C==0 member; three verified E8 callers. ABI/gameplay effect VERIFY.
